original: 相次ぐ不祥事にも関わらず、警察はオメオメ違反切符を切っている。

en.text: Despite their own scandals, the police continue to make arrests as though nothing had happened at all.
Notwithstanding their own repeated scandals, the police continue to nonchalantly issue infringement tickets.
